note: Pakistan: the Ministry of Interior's visa policy merges the categories into eleven, the Work Visa among them; Pakistan's missions abroad approve an entry work visa of up to three months on an employment agreement, without security clearance, extendable up to two years on the Board of Investment's recommendation. No performers' category or exemption is listed, so the Work Visa is the route and no days are modelled; Indian nationals' visas, dealt with by the Ministry's IP&N Wing, aren't modelled apart. Read on the Directorate General of Immigration and Passports' page of the visa policy.

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Passports (Pakistan), Visa Categories: Visa general policy for various categories
sources.said: The Ministry of Interior is responsible for granting / extending visas in the following categories of foreigners (other than Indian nationals whose cases are dealt by the IP&N Wing of the Ministry of Interior). ... Pakistan Missions abroad will receive and approve request for entry work visa up to 3 months (single entry) within the stipulated time frame of 48 Hours under intimation to ISI, IB and FIA. ... Once work visa granted for 3 months, the applicant can seek extension up to 2 years with multiple entries.
